Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - C.C. No. 1904/2022

Dear Ms. Sathe,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 July 2022 about your dispute with M/s Deccan Builders Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate.

Our advice is to seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate. Please collect the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and the municipal reply on the occupancy certificate and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
